jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  
We are seeking a skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in machine learning, data mining, and analytics, with experience in developing and deploying machine learning models. You will work closely with data scientists and software engineers to create innovative solutions that leverage AI technologies. This role requires proficiency in various programming languages and frameworks, as well as a solid understanding of big data technologies.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms for various applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Conduct data mining and analysis to extract insights from large datasets.
* Utilize machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Spark, and SAS for model training and deployment.
* Implement ETL processes for data preparation and integration from multiple sources.
* Optimize existing models for performance and scalability in production environments.
* Engage in continuous learning to stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning technologies.
* Document processes, methodologies, and findings to ensure knowledge sharing within the team.

**Experience**

* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C, and R.
* Hands\-on experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Spark) and tools (e.g., Hadoop).
* Familiarity with database design and SQL for data manipulation.
* Knowledge of unsupervised learning techniques and natural language processing (NLP).
* Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, or Talend is highly desirable.
* Understanding of linked data concepts and analytics tools like Looker.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash (Unix shell) or VBA is a plus.
* Background in quantum engineering or advanced analytics is an advantage. Join us to be part of an innovative environment where your skills will contribute to cutting\-edge projects that shape the future of technology.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data & Observability Platforms — MTS/SMTS
jobs.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Software Engineering
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**Job Summary**
---------------

We’re hiring a Software Engineer at either the Member of Technical Staff (MTS) or Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) level to join the IT Employee Success (ES) \& Finance Platform, Data and Innovations team. The final level will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, technical depth, demonstrated scope, and leadership capabilities.


Our team builds the platforms that power Employee Success and Finance systems. We’re evolving our observability capabilities beyond traditional dashboards and reactive alerts toward intelligent, agent\-assisted operations—including proactive issue detection, root\-cause analysis, and insights informed by historical telemetry.


We’re also building a unified data platform that integrates data from Workday, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems to support operational workflows, reporting, analytics, and emerging AI and agentic use cases.


This role is a strong fit for an engineer with a platform\-first mindset and experience in—or a strong interest in—data platforms, telemetry, observability, cloud infrastructure, and open\-source technologies.


**About the Role**
------------------

You’ll be a hands\-on technical contributor building reliable, reusable, and scalable platform capabilities for Employee Success and Finance systems.


At the MTS level, you’ll contribute to the design and implementation of platform components, collaborate with experienced engineers, and take increasing ownership of services and technical outcomes.


At the SMTS level, you’ll lead the design of significant platform capabilities, drive technical decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and influence the long\-term architecture and direction of the platform.


**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, and operate telemetry, observability, logging, and alerting systems that provide real\-time visibility into system health, reliability, and performance.
* Advance our observability platform beyond dashboards and reactive monitoring toward proactive, AI\- and agent\-assisted issue detection, investigation, and root\-cause analysis.
* Build and evolve data pipelines and platform services that integrate data from Workday, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems.
* Enable operational, reporting, analytics, and emerging AI and agentic use cases through reliable, secure, and well\-governed data.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines with integrated quality gates, including automated testing, security scanning, and vulnerability checks.
* Develop scalable and maintainable infrastructure and services using open\-source technologies, primarily on AWS, with some workloads on GCP.
* Partner with Employee Success, Finance, security, data, and other engineering teams to identify platform gaps and improve developer experience, data reliability, and operational intelligence.
* Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and technical planning.
* Apply and promote engineering best practices related to code quality, testing, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Contribute to reusable technical patterns, standards, and documentation across the platform.

**Core Qualifications**
-----------------------

* Professional software development experience building and operating production systems.
* Proficiency in one or more relevant programming languages, such as Java, Python, or Go.
* Experience with—or a strong interest in—observability, telemetry, logging, alerting, data pipelines, or data platforms.
* Familiarity with open\-source technologies and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and foundational security or vulnerability\-management practices.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS; GCP experience is a plus.
* Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and system\-design principles.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering and business teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Level\-Specific Expectations**
--------------------------------

### **MTS**

* Typically 3–5 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
* Experience implementing well\-defined services, platform components, or data pipelines.
* Ability to deliver reliable solutions with guidance from senior engineers.
* Willingness to incorporate feedback and develop deeper expertise in platform, data, and observability engineering.
* Ability to take ownership of components and contribute effectively to technical discussions and code reviews.

### **SMTS**

* Typically 8 or more years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
* Demonstrated experience designing and operating scalable platforms, shared services, infrastructure, or developer capabilities used by multiple teams.
* Ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from architecture through production oper

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 10/30/2026Meet the Team:
  
  

The Cisco Distributed System Engineering (DSE) group leads innovation in building products that power the world’s largest networks. As the networking industry evolves to support AI/ML workloads and a growing internet user base, our team is uniquely positioned to drive this transformation. We leverage open\-source technologies and push the boundaries of Systems and Silicon Architecture
  
  

Our solutions team works closely with large webscaler customers to replicate their networks and prepare software and hardware for deployment. We operate in fast\-paced sprints across Cisco’s product lineup, focusing on SONiC for web\-scale environments, including AI/ML, routers, and switches.
  
  

**Your Impact:**  

As a Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor to an agile team responsible for designing, developing, and executing tests to qualify network performance for AI/ML capabilities. You will take ownership of end\-to\-end product testing and provide deep\-dive production support, ensuring high\-quality deliverables in a dynamic environment.
  
You will leverage your expertise in Python automation and testing frameworks such as PyTest to streamline and enhance testing processes. Your role involves active participation in the open\-source community to drive innovation and integrate best practices into our development lifecycle.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities include:**  

* Engaging in technical discussions with customers to gather and clarify requirements.
* Building and maintaining testing environments for system and solution validation.
* Developing and enhancing test frameworks and benchmarking tools.
* Defining metrics and gathering data for network performance benchmarking.
* Conducting hands\-on troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for complex customer issues.
* Contributing to technical projects and sharing expertise to foster team\-wide excellence and technical growth.


**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in STEM with 7\+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree in STEM with 4\+ years, or PhD in STEM with 1\+ years.
* 3\+ years of experience in Python automation scripting.
* 2\+ years of experience in configuring, testing, or debugging networking systems and solutions.
* Experience with PyTest or similar open\-source QA automation frameworks.
* Experience with control and data plane technologies, including L2/L3 networking, BGP, ECMP, and VXLAN\-based EVPN fabrics.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience with test frameworks and traffic generators (both commercial and open source).
* Prior experience in customer\-facing roles.
* Exposure to network operating systems, preferably SONiC very nice to have.
* Familiarity with RDMA and HPC networks.
* Understanding of RoCE and InfiniBand protocols.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Simple**
================


Simple AI is building state of the art voice AI agents for enterprise. Our realistic agents help iconic businesses like Doordash, xAI, and Omaha Steaks handle all kinds of phone operations, from customer support to order intake to lead qualifications. We are growing revenue like crazy and looking to hire a couple founding software engineers to help us stay afloat of current customer demand and also build out systems for the future. We are very excited about the potential for AI to change the world, and work out of our SF based office.


Simple AI raised $14M from world\-class investors and operators like Y Combinator, First Harmonic, Massive Tech Ventures, Michael Seibel, Jared Friedman, Alexandr Wang, Matt Van Horn, Suhail Doshi, and Scott Wu.

  

**The Team**
============


The founders (Catheryn and Zach) met while running software teams at YC, where they shipped tons of new products for YC founders, including YC’s co\-founder matching site. Cat previously worked at Instagram and Facebook and earned degrees in math and computer science at MIT. Zach previously studied computer science and statistics at U Chicago and led software at PEAK6\. We have grown into a strong team of 20\+ and are continuing to scale quickly.

**About the Role**
==================


Simple AI builds AI voice agents that handle real customer conversations over the phone. Our agents help businesses generate revenue and improve customer retention.


We’re hiring a Platform Engineer to build and run the infrastructure behind those conversations. Real\-time voice has demanding reliability requirements: latency is immediately noticeable, calls are stateful, and deployments need to happen without interrupting customers.


You’ll work directly with the founders and engineering team to make our platform reliable, scalable, and easy to build on. This is a hands\-on engineering role with meaningful ownership over infrastructure architecture and how we ship software.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive salary \& meaningful equity
* Employee\-friendly equity terms
* An office located in SF
* Health, dental \& vision insurance
* Free lunch \& dinner at the office
* Late night Ubers
* Regular team events \& offsites

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Build and operate AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Kubernetes, including EKS clusters, networking, IAM, load balancing, and secrets management.
* Develop reusable infrastructure modules and consistent development, staging, and production environments.
* Build deployment workflows with automated checks, clear deployment visibility, and reliable rollbacks.
* Design autoscaling and graceful shutdown behavior for services handling long\-running voice conversations.
* Improve observability across infrastructure and application services, with useful dashboards, actionable alerts, and clear reliability and latency metrics.
* Investigate production issues, improve incident response, and address recurring problems at their source.
* Partner with application and AI engineers to deploy new services, improve performance, and manage infrastructure costs.
* Make it easier for engineers to provision resources, deploy changes, and debug their services safely.

**What we’re looking for**
==========================

* Hands\-on experience running Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production.
* Strong Terraform experience, including maintainable modules, state management, and safe infrastructure changes.
* A solid understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and distributed systems.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines and operating services through deployments, incidents, and growth.
* Ability to write software and automation in a language such as Python, Go, or TypeScript.
* Good judgment about when to introduce new infrastructure and when to keep things simple.
* Someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and follows problems through to a lasting fix.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with Argo CD, Helm, or other GitOps tooling.
* Familiarity with real\-time audio, SIP, WebRTC, or other latency\-sensitive systems.
* Experience operating PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, and background workers.
* Experience deploying GPU workloads or self\-hosted AI inference.
* Familiarity with infrastructure security and supporting SOC 2 requirements.

**Why Simple AI**
=================


You’ll shape the infrastructure of a growing voice AI company and see your work directly affect real customer conversations. There’s room to make architectural decisions, build useful tools, and establish engineering practices that the team will rely on as we grow.


Compensation Range: $140 \- $250,000

jobs.description:
**Senior Data Engineer – Data Quality \& Systems Forensics**
============================================================


6\-Month Contract / Fixed\-Term Role


Location: Carson, CA (hybrid) or remote with strong Pacific Time overlap  

Duration: 6 months, full\-time  

Compensation: $70K to $80K for the six\-month engagement  

Team: Global Data \& AI


**About the Role**
------------------


Dermalogica is looking for a senior, hands\-on data engineer to help us strengthen the fundamentals of our global data environment.


This is not a traditional reporting role, and it is not primarily a greenfield data engineering role. We are looking for someone who is exceptionally good at investigating how complex systems actually work, finding where data has gone wrong, fixing the underlying issue, and putting controls in place so it does not happen again.


You will inherit a prioritized backlog of known data quality and integration issues across a hybrid environment that includes ERP systems, e\-commerce platforms, marketplace data, SQL Server databases, ETL processes, cloud data warehousing, and downstream analytics.


The right person will be comfortable peeling back the layers of an unfamiliar system: starting with a number that does not make sense, tracing it through databases, views, stored procedures, integration jobs and source systems, determining exactly where and why it broke, and driving the issue through to resolution.


We are looking for someone with strong technical depth, forensic instincts, practical judgment, and the confidence to operate independently in an environment where documentation is sometimes incomplete and the answer is not always obvious.


**What You’ll Do**
------------------


* Investigate and root\-cause data discrepancies across source systems, databases, integrations, data warehouses, and reporting layers.
* Trace data end\-to\-end to understand where transformations, mappings, filters, jobs, or business rules are producing incorrect results.
* Own a prioritized backlog of data quality issues from investigation through remediation, validation, backfill, and closure.
* Audit existing SQL jobs, stored procedures, ETL processes, dependencies, and transformation logic to identify fragile or undocumented behavior.
* Identify and eliminate hardcoded business rules, silent failures, incomplete loads, duplicate data, and other recurring sources of data quality problems.
* Correct issues at the appropriate architectural layer rather than applying downstream patches.
* Recover and backfill missing or incorrect historical data and reconcile results back to source systems.
* Improve customer, channel, product, and other master\-data mappings where inconsistent logic is affecting reporting.
* Replace fragile manual data processes with governed, scheduled, and monitored pipelines where appropriate.
* Build automated reconciliation, feed\-health checks, and alerting so data failures are detected quickly rather than discovered through manual review.
* Improve dependency management, reload processes, and change controls so upstream changes do not create unexpected downstream issues.
* Document critical data lineage, system dependencies, transformation logic, and ownership as the environment is cleaned up.
* Work closely with internal IT, Finance, market teams, external development partners, and vendors to drive issues to resolution.
* Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------


### **Must Have**


* 7\+ years of hands\-on data engineering, database engineering, or closely related experience in production environments.
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL, including complex queries, views, stored procedures, scheduled jobs, and production troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines, system integrations, database dependencies, and data warehouse architecture.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and resolving data integrity or data quality incidents, not only building new pipelines.
* Ability to take an ambiguous problem — for example, “these numbers do not reconcile” — and independently determine where, when, and why the problem occurred.
* Experience tracing data across multiple systems and determining the appropriate source of truth.
* Strong analytical and forensic problem\-solving skills. You are comfortable digging through unfamiliar systems, testing assumptions, and following evidence until you understand the root cause.
* Strong practical judgment and common sense. You know when something technically works but does not make sense from a business or data perspective.
* Ability to make safe changes in shared production environments and understand downstream impacts before implementing them.
* Ability to work independently with limited direction and drive issues across multiple teams through completion.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience with BigQuery or another modern cloud data warehouse.
* Experience with SSIS, SQL Agent, or similar scheduling/orchestration technologies.
* Experience working with ERP data such as JD Edwards, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, or Business Central.
* Familiarity with commerce platforms such as Shopify or Amazon marketplace data.
* Experience working with financial or commercial datasets, including invoices, transactions, sales, returns, tax, accruals, or general\-ledger data.
* Experience reconciling data between operational systems, financial systems, warehouses, and BI/reporting tools.
* Experience with data observability, automated reconciliation, data\-quality monitoring, or building similar controls.
* Experience working with legacy systems, offshore development teams, external vendors, or environments where system knowledge is distributed across multiple groups.

There's nothing more exciting than being at the center of a rapidly growing field in technology and applying your skillsets to drive innovation and modernize the world's most complex and mission\-critical systems.

  

  

As a Site Reliability Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Enterprise Technology, Infrastructure Platforms team, you will solve complex and broad business problems with simple and straightforward solutions. Through code and cloud infrastructure, you will configure, maintain, monitor, and optimize applications and their associated infrastructure to independently decompose and iteratively improve on existing solutions. You are a significant contributor to your team by sharing your knowledge of end\-to\-end operations, availability, reliability, and scalability of your application or platform.  

  

**Job responsibilities**

* Owns end\-to\-end reliability for the ServiceNow platform, including incident response, SLO/observability, automation, and platform performance engineering
* Troubleshoots incidents/problems; leads blameless post‑mortems and drives non‑recurrence actions
* Defines/defends SLIs/SLOs and error budgets; improves telemetry, monitoring, alerting, and performance testing review
* Monitors platform and product performance metrics; partners with engineering on remediation
* Identifies and delivers stability/resiliency/performance improvements; supports platform/vendor upgrades
* Automates repetitive operational work to reduce toil
* Performs design reviews for platform/tenant implementations; partners with architecture on platform standards
* Holistically analyzes ServiceNow instances to identify/remediate resource contention across all layers of the stack; explores platform Java and JavaScript to understand ServiceNow application behavior
* Improves throughput via JVM memory allocation and garbage collection tuning; optimizes relational database performance via query refactoring and/or database tuning
* **Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate incident triage, troubleshooting, and post\-incident analysis, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.**
* **Applies enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to identify patterns in operational signals that indicate reliability risk or recurring toil, prioritizing reuse\-first improvements tied to SLO outcomes.**




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on site reliability engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Proficient in site reliability culture and principles and familiarity with how to implement site reliability within an application or platform
* Proficient in at least one programming language such as Python, Java/Spring Boot, and .Net
* Strong enterprise platform support experience and practical SRE/observability fundamentals relevant to ServiceNow
* 10\+ years in technical support, software development, performance load testing, or professional services
* Expert\-level understanding of web application stack components
* Scripting: one or more of JavaScript, Python, Perl, Unix shell, Windows PowerShell
* Experience working with/debugging object\-oriented code like Java
* Strong RDBMS experience (Oracle/MySQL/SQL Server/PostgreSQL) and performance tuning; JVM performance tuning (memory/GC) and troubleshooting in complex systems
* **Working knowledge of using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support SRE workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity**
* **Ability to validate AI\-assisted operational recommendations before applying changes, escalating when uncertain and following data sensitivity requirements**

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* ServiceNow CSA (or higher)
* Prior ServiceNow architecture exposure (training can be provided)
* Cloud/SaaS experience
* Memory management and dump analysis (Java heap dump analysis preferred)
* ITSM/ITIL/CMDB fundamentals
* Linux/Unix or Windows Server administration
* Browser/network troubleshooting tools (e.g., Firebug, Chrome DevTools, Fiddler)

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
***Urgently hiring***, we're growing fast and we need engineers as soon as possible! This could be you! We make a **commitment** to try and get back to all applicants **within 5 business days**.

The interview process is also relatively straightforward:

* A brief technical screen \+ product\-related questions.
* A flight and accommodations to NYC for a 1\.5 hour interview comprised of a 1\-hour final technical component and a 30 min behavioral chat afterwards.

We move *fast*, we hire remotely and hybrid, but we prefer in\-person in NYC. If you get the position we will happily work with you to pay a significant relocation bonus and help you find a lease (via our 3rd\-party placement services in NYC who will literally advise and help you tour apartments all day).

**SAJA** is a venture\-backed startup funded by top investors. We're building a new way to collect, trade, and engage with physical collectibles through a digital\-first experience. We're growing rapidly so we're looking for a Software Engineer with 0\-3 years of experience to help us build and ship the product, primarily on iOS, with room to work across the stack as you grow.

**What you'll do**

* Build and ship features in our iOS app, from the pack\-opening experience to collection management to payments.
* Work across the stack when a feature needs it, including the TypeScript backend that powers the app.
* Take features from a rough idea to something in front of real users, and stay with them after launch.
* Debug issues in production, including the ones that only show up on real devices and real networks.
* Work with design, product, and the rest of engineering to figure out what's worth building and what it should actually do.
* Help us make good decisions about testing, reliability, and how we handle anything that touches money.

**What we're looking for**

* Strong fundamentals in at least one language, and the ability to pick up others quickly. We use Swift and SwiftUI on iOS and TypeScript on the backend, but we care far more that you can learn a stack than that you already know ours.
* Some experience building something real, whether that's a personal project, an internship, or coursework you took further than required. We'd rather see one thing you shipped and can talk about in depth than a long list of technologies.
* The instinct to figure out why something is broken rather than trying fixes until one works.
* Ability to take an underspecified problem and ask the right questions before writing code.
* Comfort making decisions with incomplete information, and knowing when to ask instead.
* Interest in consumer products, marketplaces, gaming, collectibles, fintech, or e\-commerce.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment with significant ownership.
* Strong ability to be AI\-forward with tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and a yearly $100k token budget allotted to you.

**What this job is actually like**

You'll ship to production early, in your first couple of weeks. You'll work across most of the product rather than one corner of it, and you'll have someone senior to learn from while you do. It moves quickly, the codebase is young, and you'll have real influence over how things get built.

Although preferred, you do not need experience in collectibles or trading cards, or prior iOS experience if you're a strong engineer elsewhere. We care much more about your ability to think critically, learn quickly, and build things that work.

**Location**

We're headquartered in NYC and most of the team is here, but we hire remote and hybrid. If you're in the city, you'll find people in the office everyday. If you're not, we make sure you're not a second\-class participant, and we'll fly you in regularly so you get real time with the team.

**Compensation**

$200,000–$300,000 base, plus meaningful early\-stage equity (0\.5\-2%). The range reflects real differences in experience and demonstrated ability. We'll tell you where we think you land and why. Additional equity compensation a serious part of the offer, not a rounding error, and we're happy to walk you through the numbers so you can actually evaluate it.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision, with premiums fully covered for you and heavily subsidized for dependents
* 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO
* 16 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
* Top\-spec laptop, monitors, and whatever else makes you effective; home office stipend if you're remote
* $100k annual AI token budget, plus a small learning and conference budget
* Commuter benefits for NYC\-based folks
* Regular offsites and team dinners
* Lunch provided in the office

Even if you do not meet all the qualifications, feel free to apply if you think there might be a role for you at SAJA. Drive and passion are by far our favorite markers for success.

**Please do not apply to multiple roles within Saja. We will automatically consider you for other roles, but please apply to only one role.**

Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Gym membership
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Pet insurance
* Relocation assistance
* Unlimited paid time off
* Visa sponsorship
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10007

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**


Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting.

**Role Description**


You’ll join Tennr’s Infrastructure team as a Site Reliability Engineer, focused on the systems that keep us reliable, observable, and secure. This is a hands\-on role with real room to grow: you’ll roll out our on\-call tooling, wire observability into the product, and own the lifecycle of the credentials, certificates, and keys that protect patient data.


It’s a great fit for someone a few years into their career who wants to grow into deep SRE ownership — with strong mentorship, real problems to solve from day one, and a direct line to the reliability and security of a platform that handles PHI.

**Responsibilities**

* Continue the PagerDuty rollout across engineering teams, helping them define escalation policies, schedules, and runbooks so on\-call is calm and clear.
* Build in\-app Datadog instrumentation — metrics, traces, and alerts — working from the observability standards Infrastructure sets.
* Manage credential storage and rotation across our environments.
* Manage certificate issuance, renewal, and rotation.
* Manage encryption key lifecycle and rotation, keeping PHI protected end to end.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* 2–4 years in SRE, infrastructure, systems, or a strong adjacent engineering background.
* Familiarity with PagerDuty or a comparable on\-call and incident\-response tool.
* Hands\-on with Datadog or another observability platform, or eager to go deep on it.
* Working understanding of secrets, certificate, and key management (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager / KMS / ACM, HashiCorp Vault).
* Careful and methodical with anything touching security and rotation — you sweat the details.
* Eager to grow into broader SRE ownership, and energized by working in a regulated healthcare (HIPAA / PHI) environment.

**Why Tennr?**

* **Drive Impact:** one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact.
* **Develop Operational Expertise:** learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure.
* **Innovate with Purpose:** we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high\-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system.
* **Build Relationships:** collaborate and connect with like\-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week.
* **Free lunch!** Plus a pantry full of snacks.

**Benefits**

* Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street
* Unlimited PTO
* 100% paid employee health benefit options
* Employer\-funded 401(k) match
* Competitive parental leave


Compensation Range: $175K \- $200K

new_jobs.description:
**Senior Data Engineer – Data Quality \& Systems Forensics**
============================================================


6\-Month Contract / Fixed\-Term Role


Location: Carson, CA (hybrid) or remote with strong Pacific Time overlap  

Duration: 6 months, full\-time  

Compensation: $70K to $80K for the six\-month engagement  

Team: Global Data \& AI


**About the Role**
------------------


Dermalogica is looking for a senior, hands\-on data engineer to help us strengthen the fundamentals of our global data environment.


This is not a traditional reporting role, and it is not primarily a greenfield data engineering role. We are looking for someone who is exceptionally good at investigating how complex systems actually work, finding where data has gone wrong, fixing the underlying issue, and putting controls in place so it does not happen again.


You will inherit a prioritized backlog of known data quality and integration issues across a hybrid environment that includes ERP systems, e\-commerce platforms, marketplace data, SQL Server databases, ETL processes, cloud data warehousing, and downstream analytics.


The right person will be comfortable peeling back the layers of an unfamiliar system: starting with a number that does not make sense, tracing it through databases, views, stored procedures, integration jobs and source systems, determining exactly where and why it broke, and driving the issue through to resolution.


We are looking for someone with strong technical depth, forensic instincts, practical judgment, and the confidence to operate independently in an environment where documentation is sometimes incomplete and the answer is not always obvious.


**What You’ll Do**
------------------


* Investigate and root\-cause data discrepancies across source systems, databases, integrations, data warehouses, and reporting layers.
* Trace data end\-to\-end to understand where transformations, mappings, filters, jobs, or business rules are producing incorrect results.
* Own a prioritized backlog of data quality issues from investigation through remediation, validation, backfill, and closure.
* Audit existing SQL jobs, stored procedures, ETL processes, dependencies, and transformation logic to identify fragile or undocumented behavior.
* Identify and eliminate hardcoded business rules, silent failures, incomplete loads, duplicate data, and other recurring sources of data quality problems.
* Correct issues at the appropriate architectural layer rather than applying downstream patches.
* Recover and backfill missing or incorrect historical data and reconcile results back to source systems.
* Improve customer, channel, product, and other master\-data mappings where inconsistent logic is affecting reporting.
* Replace fragile manual data processes with governed, scheduled, and monitored pipelines where appropriate.
* Build automated reconciliation, feed\-health checks, and alerting so data failures are detected quickly rather than discovered through manual review.
* Improve dependency management, reload processes, and change controls so upstream changes do not create unexpected downstream issues.
* Document critical data lineage, system dependencies, transformation logic, and ownership as the environment is cleaned up.
* Work closely with internal IT, Finance, market teams, external development partners, and vendors to drive issues to resolution.
* Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**What We’re Looking For**

### **Must Have**


* 7\+ years of hands\-on data engineering, database engineering, or closely related experience in production environments.
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL, including complex queries, views, stored procedures, scheduled jobs, and production troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines, system integrations, database dependencies, and data warehouse architecture.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and resolving data integrity or data quality incidents, not only building new pipelines.
* Ability to take an ambiguous problem — for example, “these numbers do not reconcile” — and independently determine where, when, and why the problem occurred.
* Experience tracing data across multiple systems and determining the appropriate source of truth.
* Strong analytical and forensic problem\-solving skills. You are comfortable digging through unfamiliar systems, testing assumptions, and following evidence until you understand the root cause.
* Strong practical judgment and common sense. You know when something technically works but does not make sense from a business or data perspective.
* Ability to make safe changes in shared production environments and understand downstream impacts before implementing them.
* Ability to work independently with limited direction and drive issues across multiple teams through completion.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience with BigQuery or another modern cloud data warehouse.
* Experience with SSIS, SQL Agent, or similar scheduling/orchestration technologies.
* Experience working with ERP data such as JD Edwards, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, or Business Central.
* Familiarity with commerce platforms such as Shopify or Amazon marketplace data.
* Experience working with financial or commercial datasets, including invoices, transactions, sales, returns, tax, accruals, or general\-ledger data.
* Experience reconciling data between operational systems, financial systems, warehouses, and BI/reporting tools.
* Experience with data observability, automated reconciliation, data\-quality monitoring, or building similar controls.
* Experience working with legacy systems, offshore development teams, external vendors, or environments where system knowledge is distributed across multiple groups.

new_jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
***Urgently hiring***, we're growing fast and we need engineers as soon as possible! This could be you! We make a **commitment** to try and get back to all applicants **within 5 business days**.

The interview process is also relatively straightforward:

* A brief technical screen \+ product\-related questions.
* A flight and accommodations to NYC for a 1\.5 hour interview comprised of a 1\-hour final technical component and a 30 min behavioral chat afterwards.

We move *fast*, we hire remotely and hybrid, but we prefer in\-person in NYC. If you get the position we will happily work with you to pay a significant relocation bonus and help you find a lease (via our 3rd\-party placement services in NYC who will literally advise and help you tour apartments all day).

**SAJA** is a venture\-backed startup funded by top investors. We're building a new way to collect, trade, and engage with physical collectibles through a digital\-first experience. We're growing rapidly so we're looking for a Software Engineer with 0\-3 years of experience to help us build and ship the product, primarily on iOS, with room to work across the stack as you grow.

**What you'll do**

* Build and ship features in our iOS app, from the pack\-opening experience to collection management to payments.
* Work across the stack when a feature needs it, including the TypeScript backend that powers the app.
* Take features from a rough idea to something in front of real users, and stay with them after launch.
* Debug issues in production, including the ones that only show up on real devices and real networks.
* Work with design, product, and the rest of engineering to figure out what's worth building and what it should actually do.
* Help us make good decisions about testing, reliability, and how we handle anything that touches money.

**What we're looking for**

* Strong fundamentals in at least one language, and the ability to pick up others quickly. We use Swift and SwiftUI on iOS and TypeScript on the backend, but we care far more that you can learn a stack than that you already know ours.
* Some experience building something real, whether that's a personal project, an internship, or coursework you took further than required. We'd rather see one thing you shipped and can talk about in depth than a long list of technologies.
* The instinct to figure out why something is broken rather than trying fixes until one works.
* Ability to take an underspecified problem and ask the right questions before writing code.
* Comfort making decisions with incomplete information, and knowing when to ask instead.
* Interest in consumer products, marketplaces, gaming, collectibles, fintech, or e\-commerce.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment with significant ownership.
* Strong ability to be AI\-forward with tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and a yearly $100k token budget allotted to you.

**What this job is actually like**

You'll ship to production early, in your first couple of weeks. You'll work across most of the product rather than one corner of it, and you'll have someone senior to learn from while you do. It moves quickly, the codebase is young, and you'll have real influence over how things get built.

Although preferred, you do not need experience in collectibles or trading cards, or prior iOS experience if you're a strong engineer elsewhere. We care much more about your ability to think critically, learn quickly, and build things that work.

**Location**

We're headquartered in NYC and most of the team is here, but we hire remote and hybrid. If you're in the city, you'll find people in the office everyday. If you're not, we make sure you're not a second\-class participant, and we'll fly you in regularly so you get real time with the team.

**Compensation**

$200,000–$300,000 base, plus meaningful early\-stage equity (0\.5\-2%). The range reflects real differences in experience and demonstrated ability. We'll tell you where we think you land and why. Additional equity compensation a serious part of the offer, not a rounding error, and we're happy to walk you through the numbers so you can actually evaluate it.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision, with premiums fully covered for you and heavily subsidized for dependents
* 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO
* 16 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
* Top\-spec laptop, monitors, and whatever else makes you effective; home office stipend if you're remote
* $100k annual AI token budget, plus a small learning and conference budget
* Commuter benefits for NYC\-based folks
* Regular offsites and team dinners
* Lunch provided in the office

Even if you do not meet all the qualifications, feel free to apply if you think there might be a role for you at SAJA. Drive and passion are by far our favorite markers for success.

**Please do not apply to multiple roles within Saja. We will automatically consider you for other roles, but please apply to only one role.**

Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Gym membership
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Pet insurance
* Relocation assistance
* Unlimited paid time off
* Visa sponsorship
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10007
